notes.title: Fringe Planet now has a Discord
notes.notes:
[url=https://discord.gg/PCvGXJM][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35538225/d8a30ce991cbbeaa64d0443d146b8bbc27b2ee38.png[/img][/url]

Fringe Planet now has an official Discord! Come and join a growing community of very awesome folks who are supporting the development of Fringe Planet.

Chat with the developer, talk with the team or just join for some virtual fishing and advice about game development. 

An incredibly eldritch group of people are waiting for you... the only thing missing from the Discord is [b]you[/b]!

Join here: [url=https://discord.gg/PCvGXJM]https://discord.gg/PCvGXJM[/url]

notes.title: Fringe Planet is now live on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
I am very proud to announce that the Fringe Planet Kickstarter is now live! With gameplay videos, a detailed introduction to the game as well as the opportunity to shape the development of the game!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1759783741/fringe-planet?ref=2grtxd]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35538225/40472977eab3e4c9c0e282a16f6cb91dd44c07eb.png[/img]
[/url]

It would be incredibly awesome if you could check it out, as well as sharing it on social media. The more folks that see it, the better. This Kickstarter will allow you to shape the development of the game, with multiple different pledges that will give you a direct input into the game. I'm excited to see what you come up with :-)

[/td]
[td]
Add a name to the peon name pool - allowing your name to appear amongst the procedurally generated peons![/td]
[/tr]

There are many other rewards available so feel free to check the Kickstarter out! Thanks in advance!
